sources.title: Ludmila Koryakova, fortified settlements in the Southern Trans-Urals
sources.note: European Association of Archaeologists abstract on settlement clusters, architecture, wells, rebuilding, and chronology.

sources.title: Stephan Lindner, Chariots in the Eurasian Steppe
sources.note: Antiquity study modeling Sintashta chronology and assessing wheel pits, horse tack, burials, and chariots.

sources.title: Migrations and Cultural Evolution in the Southern Urals
sources.note: Radiocarbon synthesis for Southern Ural Bronze Age sites and changing cultural chronology.

sources.title: Sintashta-Petrovka settlement organization and demography
sources.note: Peer-reviewed settlement study estimating house size, settlement population, duration, and cemetery representation.

sources.title: Wells at Kamennyi Ambar
sources.note: Institute publisher abstract covering 18 wells, 44 radiocarbon dates, placement, and cultural phases.

sources.title: Bronze Age diet and economy at Kamennyi Ambar
sources.note: Stable-isotope and zooarchaeological study of livestock, fishing, hunting, plants, and cultivation evidence.

sources.title: Archaeobotanical analysis of plant use at Kamennyi Ambar
sources.note: Primary archaeobotanical study of charred remains, wild plants, fuel, fodder, and absent crop evidence.

sources.title: Bronze Age mobility in the Southern Urals
sources.note: Peer-reviewed synthesis testing year-round settlement, localized herding, and mobile subgroup models.

sources.title: Landscape development and soils at Kamennyi Ambar
sources.note: Geoarchaeological study of settlement topography, soils, vegetation, grazing, and human landscape effects.

sources.title: Samantha Pitman, Bronze Age metallurgical communities
sources.note: University of Sheffield thesis challenging centralized industrial and proto-state readings of household metallurgy.

sources.title: Sintashta mines: current state and analytical data
sources.note: University journal review distinguishing securely dated mines from broader ore-source assumptions.

sources.title: Metal production, mortuary ritual, and social identity
sources.note: Institute publisher abstract quantifying metal objects and tools in Sintashta burial contexts.

sources.title: Kamennyi Ambar pottery production study
sources.note: Institute conference volume reporting heterogeneous pottery practices and shared production links.

sources.title: Life in the fast lane: bioarchaeology at Kamennyi Ambar-5
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of 99 people, mortality, dental disease, stress, and traumatic injury.

sources.title: Children in Bronze Age societies of the Southern Urals
sources.note: Open scholarly paper on subadult burial proportions, grave forms, goods, and age distinctions.

sources.title: The formation of human populations in South and Central Asia
sources.note: Science study and supplementary analysis of sampled Sintashta ancestry clusters and contemporaneous genetic outliers.

sources.title: Intramural child burials in the Southern Urals
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study presenting rare settlement child burials and alternative social interpretations.

sources.title: Bryan Hanks, social organization in the Eurasian Bronze Age
sources.note: University of Pittsburgh dissertation comparing household, settlement, craft, and mortuary evidence.

sources.title: Igor Chechushkov, Bronze Age human communities in the Southern Urals
sources.note: University of Pittsburgh dissertation on settlement households, demography, cemeteries, and social organization.

sources.title: The emergence of Bronze Age chariots in eastern Europe
sources.note: Antiquity discussion of radiocarbon dates and competing interpretations of early chariot evidence.

sources.title: Indo-European loanwords and exchange in Bronze Age Asia
sources.note: Peer-reviewed linguistic study discussing Indo-Iranic reconstruction, archaeological association, and later attestations.

sources.title: Earliest evidence for Iranian languages
sources.note: Scholarly reference explaining the difficulty of matching reconstructed languages directly to archaeological cultures.

sources.title: Language, archaeology, and the Sintashta question
sources.note: Scholarly book chapter reviewing fortified sites and limits of Indo-Iranian identification arguments.

sources.title: If it was not climate change, then what was it?
sources.note: Environmental and archaeological reassessment of settlement transformation and abandonment in the region.

sources.title: Seasonality of funerary rites at Kamennyi Ambar-5
sources.note: Institute publication comparing cemetery totals, settlement duration, animal offerings, and burial seasonality.

sources.title: Textile culture in the Late Bronze Age Southern Urals
sources.note: Scholarly article reviewing impressions, fibers, wool, weaving, and uncertain cultural attribution.
